video_id.description: internal production id (the production file stem); stable across re-exports

publication_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD (channel timezone as shown in Studio); null when not supplied

duration_seconds.description: length of the published file in seconds

views.description: YouTube `views`. NOT the same metric as engaged_views

engaged_views.description: YouTube `engagedViews`: views past the first frame, or tap-to-play (https://developers.google.com/youtube/analytics/metrics). Never equal to views by definition

stayed_to_watch_percent.description: Studio 'viewed vs swiped away': share that stayed (percent)

swiped_away_percent.description: Studio 'viewed vs swiped away': share that swiped away (percent)

average_view_duration.description: seconds. Can exceed duration_seconds when playbacks repeat

average_percentage_viewed.description: percent; above 100 means repeated playback is included in this figure

subscribers_gained.description: subscribers gained attributed to this video

measurement_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 time the numbers were read; null when unknown

experiment_variant.description: `<experiment id>:<variant>` or `baseline_unplanned`; null only if never assigned

metric_source.description: which product produced the numbers: `studio` or `analytics_api`. The API excludes looping-clips traffic from averageViewDuration/averageViewPercentage since 2021-12-13, so the two must not be mixed in one comparison

recorded_on.description: date the record was added to this store

notes.description: free text, e.g. what is unknown
